# Published template image usage audit (2026-10-23)

Searched all `capture-manifest.json` files under `Invitations - this folder will be removed from production`, including Marxaba, Invitate, and Chorlove; this avoids assuming the provider from the production folder name. Source roots are listed per design below. Packaged catalog art is commonly `preview.webp`/`preview.png`; the source-owned gallery or optional creator photo behavior is summarized separately.

| Template | Source image evidence | Current catalog/initial preview art | Public behavior with no creator upload | Repair task |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Anor | Marxaba `Nikoh/templates/anor/art/*`; metadata names `preview.webp` separately | `apps/web/public/templates/anor/preview.webp` (captured named artwork; not opening art) | Source gallery adapter renders fixture placeholders; public empty gallery should stay hidden | Existing **Restore Anor and Atlas source fidelity** task owns these package files; review latest image policy there |
| Atlas | Marxaba `Nikoh/templates/atlas/art/*` (silk textile source assets) | `apps/web/public/templates/atlas/preview.webp`, portrait opening render | Gallery section needs policy verification after source repair | Existing **Restore Anor and Atlas source fidelity** task |
| Aurelia | Invitate `aurelia.html`, manifest assets incl. source gallery defaults | `apps/web/public/templates/aurelia/preview.png` | Two captured design-default photos intentionally remain in empty slots; uploaded photos replace corresponding slots | New separate task **Audit source images in remaining templates** |
| Beshik | Marxaba `Beshik to'yi/templates/beshik`; captured gallery source and separate `art/beshik.webp`, `art/venue.webp` | `apps/web/public/templates/beshik/preview.webp` | Must hide creator-photo gallery/optional creator-photo section if no uploaded image; keep source venue art if source design makes it a default | New separate task **Audit source images in remaining templates** |
| Bitiruv | Marxaba `Boshqa tadbirlar/templates/bitiruv`; `art/graduation-scene.webp` plus source gallery markup | `apps/web/public/templates/bitiruv/preview.webp` | Must hide creator-photo gallery/optional creator-photo section if no uploaded image; keep graduation scene art | New separate task **Audit source images in remaining templates** |
| Bog‘i Eram | Marxaba `Nikoh/templates/bogi-eram`; gallery and opening art are source-owned | `apps/web/public/templates/bogi-eram/preview.webp` | Confirm public gallery gate against current renderer; source/decorative birds and gate remain visible | Existing **Repair Bog‘i Eram source parity** and **Fix Bog‘i Eram catalog cover fidelity** tasks |
| Bulbul | Marxaba `Nikoh/templates/bulbul`; source gallery and cage/opening images | Existing `preview.png` is QA evidence; `catalog-cover-opening.png` is clean opening artwork | Public empty creator-photo gallery should be hidden | Existing **Fix Bulbul catalog opening cover** task |
| Chavandoz | Marxaba `Sunnat to'yi/templates/chavandoz`; source gallery plus recovered metadata preview | `apps/web/public/templates/chavandoz/preview.webp`; separate `source-preview.webp` is recovered original preview | Public gallery uses creator photos; hide when empty | Existing **Recover Chavandoz original preview** task |
| Cloud Castle | Chorlove `Web invitations/templates/cloud-castle` and `Web invitations/images/cloud-castle/*` | `preview-opening.png`; old `preview-browser-capture.jpg` retained as evidence | Bridge filters usable gallery uploads; inspect optional source-photo sections for empty gating | Existing **Clean Cloud Castle catalog cover** task |
| Doira | Marxaba `Nikoh/templates/doira`; source hero/curtain/drum art and gallery markup | `apps/web/public/templates/doira/preview.png` | Must hide creator-photo gallery/optional creator-photo sections when empty; retain intentional scene art | New separate task **Audit source images in remaining templates** |
| Evelina | Invitate `evelina.html`, manifest assets incl. hero/video and location/dress-code art | `apps/web/public/templates/evelina/preview.webp` | `assets/js/evelina.js` filters to uploaded gallery photos and hides wrapper if absent; source-owned hero/location artwork remains | New separate task **Audit source images in remaining templates** (check full preview fixture mapping) |
| Ganch | Marxaba `Nikoh/templates/ganch`; source opening doors, venue art, and gallery section | `apps/web/public/templates/ganch/preview.webp`; capture refresh underway | Confirm empty public gallery gate; opening doors and template art remain | Existing **Refresh Ganch catalog artwork provenance** task |

Confirmed cross-template mismatch: the shared `apps/web/src/modules/catalog/preview-sample.json` has six gallery entries whose URLs are empty. As a result, authentic captured gallery images that exist in provider captures are not currently supplied to catalog/initial creator previews. New user policy supersedes the older empty-icon preview rule: show authentic source images wherever available; keep fixture data ephemeral. Creator uploads still replace/map into authored content according to each template's confirmed behavior. No changes were made to any source capture.

The separate repair task is responsible for closing evidence gaps in Aurelia, Beshik, Bitiruv, Doira, and Evelina, including source fixture image mapping and empty public optional-photo section checks. Existing repair tasks own Anor/Atlas, Bog‘i Eram, Bulbul, Chavandoz, Cloud Castle, and Ganch, so this audit leaves those files untouched.
